newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait deports 37 foreigners with AIDS.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait deports 37 foreigners with AIDS.

text.p: Kuwait deported 37 foreigners with AIDS in 1996, a senior official was quoted on Monday as saying.
Rashid al-Owaish, head of public health at the Health Ministry, told al-Rai al-Aam newspaper a total of 916 foreigners suffering of "dangerous diseases" were deported in 1996.
He did not give a figure for Kuwaitis with AIDS.
The AIDS cases discovered last year, 12 less than in 1995, were among 174,063 foreigners tested in 1996. All foreigners seeking residency in Kuwait are tested for AIDS and other diseases.
